Use case: ui-mockup. Create a polished, production-quality Korean Android mobile fitness app UI concept for FitMate, inspired by the visual clarity of the actual Planfit MOBILE APP. Native flat screenshot, portrait 1080 x 2340 aspect, edge-to-edge UI, no phone bezel, no perspective, no poster framing. Precise Korean sans-serif typography similar to Pretendard, bold titles, generous 20dp margins, restrained 16dp rounded surfaces, 12dp buttons, simple consistent outline icons. Planfit-like charcoal surfaces and vivid mint used only for main action and active states. No brand illustrations, no people, no stock imagery, no anatomical models, no AI coach, no calorie estimates, no subscriptions, no website layout, no Samsung Health screen. This is an existing app UI redesign; include only specified functionality. Every Korean label must be legible and verbatim. Build one screen only. Use Android status bar 9:41 at top and a slim gesture indicator at bottom. Do not include descriptive captions outside the UI. Sample figures are fictional. All content comfortably fits in screenshot and no text overlaps.
Screen 01 HOME, DARK theme. Background #1C2025, surface #282E35, thin separators #3B424B, text #F5F7FA, secondary #AAB3BF, mint #16DFC1 with nearly black text on mint buttons.
Layout from top to bottom:
1. Small bold wordmark "FitMate" left, outline bell right. Beneath it a large two-line title "오늘도,\n나답게 운동해요".
2. Dominant spacious workout card: tiny mint eyebrow "나의 운동", large title "오늘의 운동을 시작해요", secondary text "헬스부터 러닝까지, 나의 페이스로". At bottom full width vivid mint button labeled "운동 시작" and right arrow. The card should feel premium and clear through spacing, not decorations.
3. Compact plain section "기기에 저장된 운동" with two horizontally aligned metrics: "헬스" "8회" and "러닝" "3회". Do NOT label them weekly or server totals.
4. Three equal compact shortcuts with clean outline icons and labels "메이트", "운동 기록", "인바디". No new navigation tabs.
5. Section header "커뮤니티" at left, "더보기 ›" right. One understated text-only preview item with circular generic initials/avatar, "운동친구" and "오늘도 꾸준히 한 걸음", muted "방금 전". Plenty of breathing room.
6. Bottom navigation with exactly FIVE items: "홈", "메이트", "커뮤니티", "DM", "프로필". Icons above labels. Home mint selected, others muted gray.
Main goal: workout action above social content, refined type scale and realistic touch targets. This is the normal state with no ongoing workout.

Order and precise text:
1. Compact appbar: back chevron, "운동 진행", right secondary text action "운동 종료".
2. Small progress row "운동 1 / 4" on left, mint dot and elapsed timer "14:32" right, subtle narrow progress line.

top "2세트 기록" left and segmented control "kg" selected, "lb" unselected at right.
Three clearly separated numeric input fields side by side with exact labels "중량 (kg)", "횟수", "RPE"; values "20", "10", "7" in large bold numerals. These are editable fields, enough tap room.
A modest text action "+ 메모 추가".
5. Compact recorded-set section header "기록한 세트" with "1세트 · 200 kg" right. One row with mint check "1세트", "20 kg × 10회", "RPE 7", a right chevron to existing overview/edit. No duplicate record button here.

Functional attractive fitness UI; more emphasis on the set inputs and next action than decorative empty space. Maintain readable 14–16sp supporting Korean text and 48dp minimum controls. Do not add anatomy images, AI recommendations, calories, automatic rest claims, delete action, new features or settings screen. All words sharp and exact. Same palette as reference dark home.
